description: This file contains a class called CachedTypeResolver which extends TypeResolver to provide cached and efficient type resolution in a .NET environment. It manages assemblies and type lookups, utilizing concurrent dictionaries for thread safety.

classes.name: CachedTypeResolver
classes.description: A thread-safe class that caches type and assembly lookups to optimize performance during reflection-based type resolution.

methods.name: GetName
methods.description: Returns the cached name of the provided assembly, adding it to the cache if not present.

methods.name: ResolveType
methods.description: Resolves a type by name, throwing an exception if not found.

methods.name: TryResolveType
methods.description: Attempts to resolve a type by name, returning true if successful and caching the result.

methods.name: TryPerformUncachedTypeResolution
methods.description: Performs type resolution across current domain assemblies if the type isn't cached.

methods.name: TryGetCachedType
methods.description: Checks if a type is already cached.

methods.name: AddTypeToCache
methods.description: Adds a resolved type to the cache.

methods.name: TryPerformUncachedTypeResolution
methods.description: Performs the type resolution by iterating assemblies and fallback to Type.GetType.
